achievements.name: Timber!!
achievements.description: Chop down your first tree.

steps: Chop down a tree, or pick up any wood from the world (Feywood and Pine Wood do not count).

achievements.name: You Can Do It!
achievements.description: Survive your character's first full night.

steps: Survive from dusk until dawn on a new character night — do not die before morning.

achievements.name: Ooo! Shiny!
achievements.description: Mine your first nugget of ore with a pickaxe.

steps: Mine your first nugget of ore with a pickaxe.

Applicable ores: Copper Ore Iron Ore Silver Ore Gold Ore Tin Ore Lead Ore Tungsten Ore Platinum Ore Demonite Ore Crimtane Ore Hellstone Cobalt Ore Mythril Ore Adamantite Ore Palladium Ore Orichalcum Ore Titanium Ore Chlorophyte Ore The achievement checks for the destruction of…

achievements.name: No Hobo
achievements.description: Build a house suitable enough for your first town NPC, such as the guide, to move into.

steps: Build a valid house (walls, door, table, chair, light).
Wait for any town NPC such as the Guide to move in.

achievements.name: Matching Attire
achievements.description: Equip armor in all three armor slots: head, chest, and feet.

steps: Equip armor pieces in head, chest, and legs slots (they do not need to match).

achievements.name: Stop! Hammer Time!
achievements.description: Obtain your first hammer via crafting or otherwise.

steps: Craft a wooden hammer at a workbench, or loot any hammer.
Have a hammer in your inventory.

achievements.name: I Am Loot!
achievements.description: Discover a golden chest underground and take a peek at its contents.

steps: Discover a golden chest underground and take a peek at its contents.
The Gold Chest does not need to be in underground, nor does it have to be naturally generated. [2]

achievements.name: Benched
achievements.description: Craft your first work bench.

steps: May be
Confirm you craft your first work bench.

achievements.name: Heart Breaker
achievements.description: Discover and smash your first heart crystal underground.

steps: Find a Life Crystal underground (glowing red heart crystal).
Break the Life Crystal tile with a pickaxe — picking up a dropped crystal alone does not count.

achievements.name: Watch Your Step!
achievements.description: Become a victim to a nasty underground trap.

steps: Die to an underground trap (dart, boulder, spear, explosive, etc.).
Merely taking trap damage is not enough — the trap must kill you.

achievements.name: Star Power
achievements.description: Craft a mana crystal out of fallen stars, and consume it.

steps: The achievement checks the usage of Mana Crystal. Just using a character that already consumed one will not work.
Confirm you craft a mana crystal out of fallen stars, and consume it.

achievements.name: Heavy Metal
achievements.description: Obtain an anvil made from iron or lead.

steps: Mine Iron or Lead ore, smelt bars at a Furnace.
Craft an Iron/Lead Anvil (or loot one) — having it unlocks the achievement.

achievements.name: Eye on You
achievements.description: Defeat the Eye of Cthulhu, an ocular menace who only appears at night.

steps: Craft a Suspicious Looking Eye at a Demon/Crimson Altar (lens ×6) or wait for a random night spawn.
Fight at night on platforms; defeat the Eye of Cthulhu.

achievements.name: Like a Boss
achievements.description: Obtain a boss-summoning item.

steps: Craft or loot any boss-summon item (Suspicious Looking Eye, Worm Food, etc.).
Keep it in your inventory — using it is not required for the unlock.

achievements.name: Bloodbath
achievements.description: Survive a blood moon, a nocturnal event where the rivers run red and monsters swarm aplenty.

steps: Wait for a Blood Moon (higher chance at night with certain conditions) or trigger one with a Bloody Tear.
Survive until dawn without soft-locking — staying alive through the night unlocks it.

achievements.name: Hold on Tight!
achievements.description: Equip your first grappling hook.

steps: To get this achievement, the grappling hook needs to be in the grappling hook slot.
Confirm you equip your first grappling hook.

achievements.name: Smashing, Poppet!
achievements.description: Using explosives or your trusty hammer, smash a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart in the evil parts of your world.

steps: Find Shadow Orbs (Corruption) or Crimson Hearts underground.
Smash one with bombs or the hammer — the first smash also triggers a meteor later.

achievements.name: Head in the Clouds
achievements.description: Equip a pair of wings.

steps: Fledgling Wings count towards this achievement. The wings shown in the achievement icon appear to be Angel Wings.
Confirm you equip a pair of wings.

achievements.name: It's Getting Hot in Here
achievements.description: Spelunk deep enough to reach the molten underworld.

steps: Dig downward through caverns until the backdrop turns to lava / ash.
Enter the Underworld biome at the bottom of the world.

achievements.name: Pretty in Pink
achievements.description: Kill pinky.

steps: Kill pinky.
Probably

achievements.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
achievements.description: Defeat an enemy by running it over with a minecart.

steps: Ride a minecart and run over an enemy to kill it.
Laser damage from the Minecart Upgrade Kit does not count.

achievements.name: Jeepers Creepers
achievements.description: Stumble into a spider cavern in the underground.

steps: Explore Underground / Cavern layers looking for web-filled tunnels.
Enter a Spider Nest / spider cavern biome.

achievements.name: Fashion Statement
achievements.description: Equip armor or vanity clothing in all three social slots.

steps: Place armor or vanity items into all three social/vanity armor slots.

achievements.name: Goblin Punter
achievements.description: Triumph over a goblin invasion, a ragtag regiment of crude, barbaric, pointy-eared warriors and their shadowflame sorcerers.

steps: Triumph over a goblin invasion, a ragtag regiment of crude, barbaric, pointy-eared warriors and their shadowflame sorcerers.
Possible

achievements.name: Throwing Lines
achievements.description: Throw a yoyo.

steps: Obtain any yoyo and throw it once (left-click with it equipped).

achievements.name: Hey! Listen!
achievements.description: Encounter a fairy.

steps: Encounter a fairy.
The fairy can be either naturally spawned or released by a player.

achievements.name: Marathon Medalist
achievements.description: Travel a total of 26.2 miles on foot.

steps: Walk 26.2 miles on foot (69,168 tiles).
Mount travel and The Tongue drag do not count.

achievements.name: Slippery Shinobi
achievements.description: Defeat King Slime, the lord of all things slimy.

steps: Use a Slime Crown (Gel + Gold/Platinum Crown) or let the rare spawn occur.
Defeat King Slime — open space helps when he teleports.

achievements.name: Boned
achievements.description: Defeat Skeletron, the cursed guardian of the dungeon.

steps: In a Corruption/Crimson world, smash enough Shadow Orbs/Crimson Hearts or fight Skeletron at the Old Man / Dungeon entrance at night.
Defeat Skeletron to unlock the Dungeon.

achievements.name: Lucky Break
achievements.description: Survive a long fall with just a sliver of health remaining.

steps: Disable fall-damage negation (no wings/cloud bottles for the fall).
Fall far enough to survive with less than 10% max HP remaining.

achievements.name: The Cavalry
achievements.description: Equip a mount.

steps: Obtain any mount (e.g. Slimy Saddle from King Slime, or others).
Equip it in the mount slot and use the mount hotkey once.

achievements.name: Into Orbit
achievements.description: You can only go down from here!

steps: You can only go down from here!.
Reach the top of Space.

achievements.name: Where's My Honey?
achievements.description: Discover a large bee's hive deep in the jungle.

steps: Discover a large bee's hive deep in the jungle.
Only requires entering the Bee Hive. Unsafe Hive Walls must be behind the player.

achievements.name: Quiet Neighborhood
achievements.description: Enter a misty graveyard filled with the surly dead.

steps: Enter a misty graveyard filled with the surly dead.
At least 7 Tombstones are required. The achievement icon is possibly

achievements.name: Dungeon Heist
achievements.description: Steal a key from the dungeon's undead denizens, and unlock one of their precious golden chests.

steps: After Skeletron, explore the Dungeon and kill Angry Bones / Dark Casters for Golden Keys.
Open a Locked Gold Chest with a Golden Key.

achievements.name: Sting Operation
achievements.description: Defeat the Queen Bee, the matriarch of the jungle hives.

steps: In the Underground Jungle, destroy a larva in a hive or use an Abeemination.
Defeat Queen Bee.

achievements.name: Bulldozer
achievements.description: Destroy a total of 10,000 tiles.

steps: Mine 10,000 tiles with pickaxes/drills/shovel/Drill Mount.
Multi-tile objects usually count as 1 — explosives that do not use those tools may not count.

achievements.name: Still Hungry
achievements.description: Defeat the Wall of Flesh, the master and core of the world who arises after a great, burning sacrifice.

steps: Drop a Guide Voodoo Doll into lava in the Underworld (Guide must be alive).
Defeat the Wall of Flesh to enter Hardmode.

achievements.name: It's Hard!
achievements.description: Unleash the ancient spirits of light and darkness across your world, enabling much stronger foes and showering the world with dazzling treasures (and rainbows!).

steps: Defeat the Wall of Flesh in a pre-Hardmode world to unlock Hardmode.
The achievement can also unlock if another player in your world kills the Wall of Flesh.

achievements.name: Sticky Situation
achievements.description: Survive the slime rain, where gelatinous organisms fall from the sky in droves.

steps: Wait for a Slime Rain event (or keep playing until one begins).
Defeat King Slime during that Slime Rain.

achievements.name: Begone, Evil!
achievements.description: Smash a demon or crimson altar with a powerful, holy hammer.

steps: Enter Hardmode, craft a Pwnhammer (or any 80%+ hammer).
Smash a Demon Altar or Crimson Altar.

achievements.name: Til Death...
achievements.description: Kill the groom.

steps: Kill the groom.
Likely

achievements.name: Extra Shiny!
achievements.description: Mine a powerful ore that has been newly blessed upon your world.

steps: Mine a powerful ore that has been newly blessed upon your world.

Applicable ores: Cobalt Ore Mythril Ore Adamantite Ore Palladium Ore Orichalcum Ore Titanium Ore The achievement checks for the destruction of the ore tile. Any method except Block Swap can be used; viable options include directly mining the ore (regardless of if it is natural…

achievements.name: Mastermind
achievements.description: Defeat the Brain of Cthulhu, an enourmous demon brain which haunts the creeping crimson.

steps: In a Crimson world, smash 3 Crimson Hearts or use a Bloody Spine in the Crimson.
Defeat the Brain of Cthulhu (and its Creepers).

achievements.name: Worm Fodder
achievements.description: Defeat the Eater of Worlds, a massive worm whom dwells in the corruption.

steps: In a Corruption world, smash 3 Shadow Orbs or use Worm Food in the Corruption.
Defeat all segments of the Eater of Worlds.

achievements.name: Deceiver of Fools
achievements.description: Kill a nymph.

steps: Find a Lost Girl underground, let her transform into a Nymph, then kill the Nymph.
Killing the Lost Girl before transformation does not count.

achievements.name: There are Some Who Call Him...
achievements.description: Kill Tim.

steps: Find and kill Tim (rare underground mage enemy) in the caverns.

achievements.name: Get a Life
achievements.description: Consume a life fruit, which grows in the thick of subterranean jungle grass.

steps: The achievement checks the usage of Life Fruit. Just using a character that already consumed one will not work.
Confirm you consume a life fruit, which grows in the thick of subterranean jungle grass.

achievements.name: Feeling Petty
achievements.description: Deliver headpats to the town pet.

steps: Get a town pet to move in (cat/dog/bunny licenses from the Zoologist).
Interact to give the town pet headpats.

achievements.name: Walk the Plank
achievements.description: Triumph over a pirate invasion, a group of pillagers from the sea out for your booty... and your life!

steps: In Hardmode, wait for or use a Pirate Map to start a Pirate Invasion.
Survive until the invasion progress reaches 100%.

achievements.name: Robbing the Grave
achievements.description: Obtain a rare treasure from a difficult monster in the dungeon.

steps: After Plantera, dungeon enemies can drop rare biome chest keys / bones gear.
Obtain a rare dungeon treasure drop (e.g. from difficult post-Plantera dungeon foes).

achievements.name: Buckets of Bolts
achievements.description: Defeat the three nocturnal mechanical menaces: the Twins, the Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.

steps: Gather a summon item / wait for the natural spawn conditions for the three nocturnal mechanical menaces: the Twins.
Clear an arena (platforms, campfires, heart lanterns), then defeat the three nocturnal mechanical menaces: the Twins.

achievements.name: Completely Awesome
achievements.description: Obtain a minishark.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: a minishark.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Kill the Sun
achievements.description: Survive a solar eclipse, a day darker than night filled with creatures of horror.

steps: Survive a solar eclipse, a day darker than night filled with creatures of horror.
Possible

achievements.name: Dead Men Tell No Tales
achievements.description: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could open the chest that you didn't stop to think if you should.

steps: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could open the chest that you didn't stop to think if you should.
" Dead men tell no tales" is a well-known proverb, often used as a motive for murder. Tooltip is

achievements.name: The Great Southern Plantkill
achievements.description: Defeat Plantera, the overgrown monstrosity of the jungle's depths.

steps: Gather a summon item / wait for the natural spawn conditions for Plantera.
Clear an arena (platforms, campfires, heart lanterns), then defeat Plantera.

achievements.name: Photosynthesis
achievements.description: Mine chlorophyte, an organic ore found deep among the thickest of flora.

steps: Mine chlorophyte, an organic ore found deep among the thickest of flora.

The achievement checks for the destruction of the ore tile. Any method except Block Swap can be used; viable options include directly mining the ore (regardless of if it is naturally generated or manually placed), using explosives, using Drill Mount, or using Digging Molecart.…

achievements.name: Lihzahrdian Idol
achievements.description: Defeat Golem, the stone-faced ritualistic idol of the lihzahrd tribe.

steps: Gather a summon item / wait for the natural spawn conditions for Golem.
Clear an arena (platforms, campfires, heart lanterns), then defeat Golem.

achievements.name: Miner for Fire
achievements.description: Craft a molten pickaxe using the hottest of materials.

steps: Gather Hellstone in The Underworld and craft a Molten Pickaxe at an anvil/forge.
The pickaxe must be crafted by you — finding one does not count.

achievements.name: The Frequent Flyer
achievements.description: Spend over 1 gold being treated by the nurse.

steps: Pay the Nurse for healing until you have spent over 1 gold total.
Make her unhappy to raise prices, or use late-game healing costs to finish faster.

achievements.name: Heliophobia
achievements.description: Trick a gnome into turning into stone!

steps: Trick a gnome into turning into stone!.
Heliophobia is the fear of the sun. Note that Gnomes are likely to spawn inside a naturally generated Living Tree.

achievements.name: Funkytown
achievements.description: Build or encounter a glowing mushroom field above the surface.

steps: Build or encounter a glowing mushroom field above the surface.
Requires 100 Glowing Mushroom biome blocks located on the surface.

achievements.name: Temple Raider
achievements.description: Breach the impenetrable walls of the jungle temple.

steps: Defeat Plantera to obtain a Temple Key (or open the Lihzahrd door another valid way).
Unlock the Jungle Temple Lihzahrd Door.

achievements.name: Topped Off
achievements.description: Attain maximum health and mana possible without accessories or buffs.

steps: Consume Life Crystals and Life Fruit to reach 500 HP, and Mana Crystals to reach 200 mana.
Temporary buffs (Lifeforce Potion, gear mana) do not count — the base stats must be maxed.

achievements.name: Jolly Jamboree
achievements.description: What you're celebrating doesn't matter, just throw a party already!

steps: What you're celebrating doesn't matter, just throw a party already!.
Parties initiated by the Party Center are eligible for this achievement. May be

achievements.name: Obsessive Devotion
achievements.description: Defeat the Ancient Cultist, fanatical leader of the dungeon coven.

steps: Defeat the Lunatic Cultist at the Dungeon entrance after Golem.
This starts the Lunar Events.

achievements.name: Rock Bottom
achievements.description: The only way is up!

steps: The only way is up!.
Reach the bottom of The Underworld.

achievements.name: Champion of Terraria
achievements.description: Defeat the Moon Lord.

steps: Defeat the Moon Lord after completing the Lunar Events.

achievements.name: Tin-Foil Hatter
achievements.description: Triumph over a martian invasion, when beings from out of this world come to scramble your brains and probe you in uncomfortable places.

steps: Shoot a Martian Probe and let it escape to trigger the Martian Madness event.
Defeat the invasion, including the Martian Saucer threat.

achievements.name: Sword of the Hero
achievements.description: Obtain a Terra Blade, forged from the finest blades of light and darkness.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: a Terra Blade, forged from the finest blades of light and darkness.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Star Destroyer
achievements.description: Defeat the four celestial towers of the moon.

steps: During the Lunar Events, damage and defeat all four Celestial Pillars.
You must deal at least 1 damage to each pillar before it dies.

achievements.name: Drax Attax
achievements.description: Craft a drax or pickaxe axe using hallowed bars, and the souls of the three mechanical bosses.

steps: Open the crafting menu and craft: a drax or pickaxe axe using hallowed bars, and the souls of the three mechanical bosses..

achievements.name: Fish Out of Water
achievements.description: Defeat Duke Fishron, mutant terror of the sea.

steps: Gather a summon item / wait for the natural spawn conditions for Duke Fishron.
Clear an arena (platforms, campfires, heart lanterns), then defeat Duke Fishron.

achievements.name: Big Booty
achievements.description: Unlock one of the dungeon's large, mysterious chests with a special key.

steps: After Plantera, obtain a Biome Key matching a Biome Chest in the Dungeon.
Open that Biome Chest.

achievements.name: Just Desserts
achievements.description: Defeat Queen Slime, giving the coup-de-grace to the sovereign of all that jiggles.

steps: In Hardmode Hallow, use a Gelatin Crystal to summon Queen Slime.
Defeat Queen Slime — focus adds and keep mobile during her aerial phase.

achievements.name: Sick Throw
achievements.description: Obtain the Terrarian.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: the Terrarian.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Slayer of Worlds
achievements.description: Defeat every boss in Terraria.

steps: Defeat the classic boss set required by the achievement (15 bosses including both evil bosses and the Moon Lord).
Empress of Light, Deerclops, and Queen Slime are not required for this older achievement.

achievements.name: Servant-in-Training
achievements.description: Complete your 1st quest for the angler.

steps: Find the Angler sleeping near water (often Ocean).
Complete his first fishing quest by turning in the requested fish.

achievements.name: It Can Talk?!
achievements.description: Build a house in a mushroom biome and have the Truffle move in.

steps: Build a valid house in a surface Glowing Mushroom biome.
Wait for the Truffle NPC to move in.

achievements.name: Archaeologist
achievements.description: Kill Doctor Bones.

steps: Kill Doctor Bones.
Doctor Bones is a parody of Indiana Jones, who is also known as Dr. Jones.

achievements.name: A Shimmer In The Dark
achievements.description: Shimmer an item into another item. What other transmutations can you find?

steps: Shimmer an item into another item. What other transmutations can you find?.
The transmutation can be decrafting an item or any of the special item transmutations.

achievements.name: Baleful Harvest
achievements.description: Reach the 15th wave of a pumpkin moon, where evil lurks among the autumn harvest.

steps: Use a Pumpkin Moon Medallion at night.
Reach wave 15 of the Pumpkin Moon.

achievements.name: Leading Landlord
achievements.description: Meet with a tenant who's as happy as they possibly can be!

steps: Meet with a tenant who's as happy as they possibly can be!.

Homeless NPCs do not grant this achievement. Can be easily achieved by housing the Party Girl, Wizard, and Zoologist in the Hallow biome and then speaking with the Party Girl, or housing the Arms Dealer and the Nurse in the Desert and talking to the Arms Dealer.

achievements.name: Boots of the Hero
achievements.description: Obtain the Terraspark Boots, forged from the finest boots of fire and ice.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: the Terraspark Boots, forged from the finest boots of fire and ice.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Infinity +1 Sword
achievements.description: Obtain the Zenith, the culmination of a journey forged into the ultimate sword.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: the Zenith, the culmination of a journey forged into the ultimate sword.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Real Estate Agent
achievements.description: Have all possible town NPCs living in your world.

steps: Build valid housing and get all town NPCs living in your world.
Traveling Merchant, Old Man, Skeleton Merchant, and Santa Claus do not count toward the requirement.

achievements.name: An Eye For An Eye
achievements.description: Defeat Deerclops, the chilly one-eyed monstrosity from a foreign land.

steps: Use a Deer Thing in a snow biome (or meet the spawn conditions).
Defeat Deerclops.

achievements.name: Fae Flayer
achievements.description: Defeat the Empress of Light, responsible for all those flashy lights and glitter.

steps: Gather a summon item / wait for the natural spawn conditions for the Empress of Light.
Clear an arena (platforms, campfires, heart lanterns), then defeat the Empress of Light.

achievements.name: Gelatin World Tour
achievements.description: Defeat every type of slime there is!

steps: Defeat every slime type counted by the achievement (including Pinky, Crimslime variants, etc.).
Use the wiki achievements page checklist — missing one slime blocks the unlock.

achievements.name: A Rather Blustery Day
achievements.description: Fly a kite on a windy day.

steps: Obtain any kite (windy-day wares / Soft Toys).
Use the kite during a Windy Day weather event.

achievements.name: Dye Hard
achievements.description: Equip a dye in every possible dye slot.

steps: Fill every dye slot: 3 armor dyes, 5 accessory dyes, and 5 equipment dyes (pet, light pet, minecart, mount, hook).

achievements.name: Do You Want to Slay a Snowman?
achievements.description: Triumph over the frost legion, a festive family of maniacal snowman mobsters.

steps: Use a Snow Globe (Hardmode present from presents) to summon the Frost Legion.
Defeat the Frost Legion invasion.

achievements.name: You and What Army?
achievements.description: Command nine summoned minions simultaneously.

steps: Raise minion capacity (armor, accessories, potions) and summon until nine minions are active at once.
You can briefly hit 9 by summoning one more at the cap before the oldest despawns.

achievements.name: Glorious Golden Pole
achievements.description: Obtain a golden fishing rod.

steps: Reach 50 Angler quests for the Golden Fishing Rod reward (or obtain it equivalently).
Have the Golden Fishing Rod in your inventory.

achievements.name: Mecha Mayhem
achievements.description: Do battle against the Twins, the Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime simultaneously and emerge victorious.

steps: In Hardmode, summon The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime so all three exist at once.
Defeat all three without any despawning — Mechdusa does not count.

achievements.name: Ice Scream
achievements.description: Reach the 15th wave of a frost moon, where the festive season quickly degrades into madness.

steps: Use a Naughty Present at night in Hardmode.
Reach wave 15 of the Frost Moon.

achievements.name: Good Little Slave
achievements.description: Complete your 10th quest for the angler.

steps: Complete your 10th quest for the angler.
Quests are cumulative across characters and worlds.

achievements.name: A Rare Realm
achievements.description: Some very special seeds can lead to unique and rewarding experiences. Can you find one?

steps: Some very special seeds can lead to unique and rewarding experiences. Can you find one?.
The achievement is granted when playing in a world with any special world seed attribute. As a result, worlds with these attributes created by world editors are also eligible. [7]

achievements.name: Hero of Etheria
achievements.description: Repel the strongest forces the Old One's Army can muster.

steps: Repel the strongest forces the Old One's Army can muster.
Achievement is granted after defeating Betsy, upon the status message, " The old one's army has been defeated!"

achievements.name: Prismancer
achievements.description: Obtain a rainbow rod.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: a rainbow rod.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Ankhumulation Complete
achievements.description: Obtain the Ankh Shield, the finest protection from unpleasant maladies and ailments.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: the Ankh Shield, the finest protection from unpleasant maladies and ailments.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Torch God
achievements.description: Invoked the wrath of the God of Torches, and survived long enough to earn its blessing.

steps: Place many torches in a small underground area to anger the Torch God.
Survive the torchfire barrage to receive the Torch God’s Favor.

achievements.name: Going Oldschool
achievements.description: Bring back the original title screen.

steps: From the main menu settings / title options, enable the original title screen habit.
Or unlock it via the anniversary easter egg — return to the title to confirm.

achievements.name: Black Mirror
achievements.description: Obtain the Cell Phone. You'll never leave home without it again.

steps: Progress the relevant biome, crafting station, or boss drops until you can obtain: the Cell Phone. You'll never leave home without it again.
Have the item in your inventory — equipping is only required if the description says so.

achievements.name: Trout Monkey
achievements.description: Complete your 25th quest for the angler.

steps: Keep completing daily Angler quests.
Turn in your 25th Angler quest.

achievements.name: Don't Dread on Me
achievements.description: Defeat the Dreadnautilus, murderous mollusk lurking beneath the surface of the sanguine seas.

steps: Gather a summon item / wait for the natural spawn conditions for the Dreadnautilus.
Clear an arena (platforms, campfires, heart lanterns), then defeat the Dreadnautilus.

achievements.name: Not the Bees!
achievements.description: Fire a Bee Gun while wearing a full set of Bee Armor.

steps: Equip a full set of Bee armor (not the vanity Bee set).
Fire the Bee Gun while wearing that set.

achievements.name: Hot Reels!
achievements.description: Drop a lure in a pool of lava for a pre-fried haul!

steps: Drop a lure in a pool of lava for a pre-fried haul!.
To do fishing in lava, Hotline Fishing Hook, Lavaproof Fishing Hook or its upgrade, or bait found in the Underworld is required.

achievements.name: Rainbows and Unicorns
achievements.description: Fire a rainbow gun while riding on a unicorn.

steps: Mount a Unicorn (Blessed Apple).
While mounted, fire a Rainbow Gun.

achievements.name: Fortune Favors the Bould
achievements.description: Discover a friendly boulder.

steps: Discover a friendly boulder.
The Rainbow Boulder does not need to be naturally generated to trigger this achievement, and as such a crafted Rainbow Boulder will also work.

achievements.name: Fast and Fishious
achievements.description: Complete your 50th quest for the angler.

steps: Continue Angler quests across many days (multiple worlds help).
Complete 50 Angler quests total.

achievements.name: Feast of Midas
achievements.description: Obtain Golden Delight, the highest quality meal made from the highest quality . . . ingredients.

steps: Gather Golden animals / gold critters and cook at a cooking pot / cauldron.
Craft Golden Delight.

achievements.name: The Great Slime Mitosis
achievements.description: Find all of the Slime Pets and have them move in!

steps: Find all town Slime pets (various rare conditions / gifts).
Have every slime pet move into town housing.

achievements.name: To Infinity... and Beyond!
achievements.description: Fly a Kwad Racer into outer space.

steps: Obtain a Kwad Racer drone (travel shop / loot).
Fly the Kwad Racer up until you leave the top of the world into space.

achievements.name: Unusual Survival Strategies
achievements.description: Delay death from drowning by drinking water. It doesn't make much sense, but you did what you had to do.

steps: Delay death from drowning by drinking water. It doesn't make much sense, but you did what you had to do.
The player's breath meter has to be depleted (i.e. losing health due to drowning) when the Bottled Water is consumed.

achievements.name: Spicy Licks
achievements.description: Jam out on a six stringed instrument.

steps: Obtain a guitar-type instrument item (e.g. from underground / drops).
Use it to play / jam (interact or fire the instrument).

achievements.name: New Digs
achievements.description: Give any villager a new look.

steps: Give any villager a new look.
Can be achieved by using Shimmer or Shimmer Gun.

achievements.name: Conservationist
achievements.description: Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.

steps: Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.
Can only be done by planting directly. Acorns, Gemcorns, Sakura Saplings, and Yellow Willow Saplings are all counted.

achievements.name: Supreme Helper Minion!
achievements.description: Complete a grand total of 200 quests for the angler.

steps: Complete Angler quests until you reach 200 total (shared across characters/worlds).
Turn in one quest per day — this is a long-term grind.

achievements.name: And Good Riddance!
achievements.description: Completely purify all Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow from your world, until the Dryad is satisfied!

steps: Completely purify all Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow from your world, until the Dryad is satisfied!.

Can be obtained pre-Hardmode. Because Skyblock worlds generate without an evil biome by default, one can easily acquire this achievement by defeating the Eye of Cthulhu and checking their world's status before creating an artificial evil biome.

achievements.name: Training Day
achievements.description: Get your villagers fully combat ready.

steps: Get your villagers fully combat ready.
Advanced Combat Techniques can be obtained by fishing during a Blood Moon. Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two can be obtained by throwing a Spell Tome into Shimmer.

achievements.name: Organized Chaos
achievements.description: Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.

steps: Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.
Its sprite might be

achievements.name: Sea You Later
achievements.description: Craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.

steps: Only detects for Shellphone (Home). If another variant has already been obtained, switch it back to Home variant and throw it out. Picking it back up grants the achievement.
Confirm you craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.

achievements.name: Interdimensional Recycling
achievements.description: Give the Dryad a can of Joja Cola.

steps: Find Joja Cola from fishing or crates.
Throw / give the Joja Cola to the Dryad (trash interaction).

achievements.name: Grave Mistake
achievements.description: “Accidentally” kill a friend with your tombstone.

steps: “Accidentally” kill a friend with your tombstone.
Tombstone projectiles will deal damage when the For the Worthy seed is active.

achievements.name: On Fleek
achievements.description: Spot the sun on a “cool” day.

steps: Spot the sun on a “cool” day.

The player has to wear Sunglasses in a vanity slot when the following conditions are met: The player is above surface. The Remix seed is not active. It is not raining. The time is between 5:30 AM and 6:30 PM.

achievements.name: Terrarist
achievements.description: Scare your villagers with a stink bug sword.

steps: Scare your villagers with a stink bug sword.
The player does not need to kill the NPC, damaging them is sufficient.

achievements.name: Book Worm
achievements.description: Catalogue every creature in the world.

steps: Catalogue every creature in the world.

Enemy and boss entries are unlocked by killing the entity. Critter entries are unlocked by coming into proximity with the critter (about 15 tiles). NPC entries are unlocked by opening the NPC's dialogue window.

achievements.name: Queen Machine
achievements.description: Defeated the combined form of the 3 mechanical giants.

steps: Defeated the combined form of the 3 mechanical giants.
Mechdusa can only be fought in worlds that have both the For the Worthy and Remix seeds active.

achievements.name: Rollin’ In Your Grave
achievements.description: Take a ride in your final resting place.

steps: Obtain a coffin baby / coffin mount related item from appropriate events.
Take a ride using that mount.

achievements.name: My People Need Me
achievements.description: Embark on a one way trip into outer space.

steps: Embark on a one way trip into outer space.

The player can go out of the top world border in either of the following conditions: The Remix seed is active. The player is within 250 tiles from second phase Brain of Cthulhu when the For the Worthy seed is active. Note that doing so kills the player if the player is not in …

achievements.name: Boulder Lord
achievements.description: Prove your worth against the Moon Lord's worst.

steps: Prove your worth against the Moon Lord's worst.
Defeating the Moon Lord in a Zenith world will also trigger the achievement.

achievements.name: It’s Shaling Outside
achievements.description: Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.

steps: Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.
A Boulder rain can occur on worlds with a combination of Drunk + For the Worthy special seeds during a Thunderstorm.

achievements.name: Extra Life
achievements.description: Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.

steps: Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.
The character must have more than 60 maximum health for the respawn to happen.

achievements.name: Mini-Me
achievements.description: Become a Moon Lord impersonator.

steps: Become a Moon Lord impersonator.

The Moon Lord Mask is dropped by the Moon Lord. The Moon Lord Torso can be found inside Dungeon chest or Golden Lock Boxes in a For the Worthy world. The Moon Lord Legs can be found inside Drunk world chests.

achievements.name: Fear The Sun
achievements.description: Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.

steps: Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.
The Vampire set has to be shown on the character, i.e. it cannot be overridden by vanity armor or accessories like the Moon Charm.

achievements.name: Trash Compactor
achievements.description: Research 50% of all items in Journey Mode.

steps: Research 50% of all items in Journey Mode.

Only counts items that are fully researched, i.e. can be duplicated. There are a total of 6138 items that can be researched, which means that at least 3069 items have to be researched. Among all items that can be researched, there are 2 unobtainable items: Bone Block and the F…
